svg.title: Account and security strategy for a serverless data platform - AWS reference reconstruction
svg.desc: Eleven AWS account roles from the AWS reference, including management, security, network, production analytics, ML sandbox, audit, dashboards, DevOps, analytics sandbox, ingestion and shared services. Account inventories without reference arrows are not wired with invented runtime dependencies.
